# Refer to the Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS for recommendations

Outpatient recommendations and orders are not available for this infectious
disease. Refer to the Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS for treatment options.
Inpt: ORZID3 GMENU ABX REFER TO INPATIENT CDSS
